description:
Use this when the user needs historical detail from an Indian company's earlier filings, for example a prior order value or commissioning date.

Returns passages from the company's filings that contain the search words, each with its page number, filing date and a link to the PDF. `search_text` is a few distinctive words: a passage matches if it contains any of them, best matches first, and words such as AND or OR are not operators. `from_date` and `to_date` (ISO) limit the filing date. `document_types` limits the kind of filing to a list from: concall, presentation, order_win, rating, debt_security, acquisition, results, press_release, sast_disclosure, corp_action, governance_change, fund_raise, scheme_of_arrangement, business_update, annual_report, brsr, meeting_notice, compliance_noise, other; any other value matches nothing. `limit` is at most 20 (default 10), with at most two passages per filing. Only filings DalalOS has already read are searched, so no match does not mean the company never disclosed it; `coverage` shows what is indexed. This tool never queues a filing for reading.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

search_text.description: Words to find in the company's indexed filings, e.g. "fraud".
search_text.title: Search Text

name: search_company_disclosures
title: Search past filings
